items.question: Where is the flagship?
items.answer: Shop No. 6 in the Multistorey Car Park Building (Mariyam Plaza) in the Gold Souq Extension, Deira, directly behind RAK Bank. The Sharjah branches are in Safari Mall and Rolla Mall, and the Abu Dhabi branch is in Madinat Zayed.

items.question: Where can I park?
items.answer: At the Gold Souq Extension the shop is inside the multistorey car park building itself, so paid parking is directly above. The Sharjah branches use the mall car parks.

items.question: How do I get to the Deira branch by metro?
items.answer: Gold Souq and Al Ras stations on the Green Line are the nearest stops, each about ten minutes on foot from the Gold Souq Extension.

items.question: Is the same piece available at every branch?
items.answer: Not always. Pieces move between branches, so send the reference on WhatsApp and we will tell you where it is and bring it to the branch you prefer, usually with a day’s notice.

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: No. Walk in any time during opening hours. For a bridal consultation or a custom design, message us on WhatsApp first so the right pieces are ready.
